conviction_note: Q1 (Jun-Aug) is visible from the company's own auction-result disclosures (gross 629m yen vs 548.5m a year ago, plus a wine sale that did not exist last Q1) and a restructured cost base, so the loss should narrow sharply from -203m yen while staying a loss against a +150m full-year plan the company has reaffirmed three times since July; all of it is public, and a ~29%-of-shares margin long (July data) is the one place sellers could come from. That leaves a findings sum of +0.4 and a near-coin-flip p_up (51) on a 5.0% scale, giving +0.1.

findings.finding: Q1 FY2027 (Jun-Aug 2026) auction gross is 629.4m yen across three disclosed sales (6/13 wine 204.5m, 7/5 iArt No.95 286.9m, 7/18 Shinwa 138.0m; buyer-premium fees 82.1m), against 548.5m yen auction gross and 115.1m auction sales in Q1 FY2026, which had no wine auction; with SG&A down from 301m yen in Q1 FY26 to ~236-247m a quarter in Q2-Q4 FY26, the Q1 operating loss should be roughly half of last year's -203m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last Q1 (released 2025-10-10 16:00, a -203m yen operating loss with no auction disclosures beforehand) fell -8.45% on the reaction day 2025-10-14. Since the company started disclosing every auction, the quarterly reactions have been small: H1 2026-01-13 +1.03%, Q3 2026-04-13 -0.27%, FY 2026-07-15 +4.66% (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the three results were filed on TDnet. What has not been printed is how they add up against last year. Nobody covers the name, there is no consensus, and private-sale revenue (82.6m yen last Q1) is not disclosed between prints. If the market had marked a halved loss, the stock would not have drifted -6.2% over the five sessions into the print.
findings.independence: Q4 FY26 operating swing to +97m yen (+155m before the inventory write-down) on the restructured cost base, from the FY presentation https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594178.pdf. That is a different document, but the inference is the same.

findings.finding: The company has said 'no change to the published full-year forecast' in each of its last three auction notices (2026-07-21, 09-14, 09-28), and the September sales alone (Q2) grossed 854m yen (223.5m + 507.3m + 123.7m), against about 1,081m yen of auction gross for the whole of Q2 FY26 (Sep-Nov). A cut to the +150m OP plan at this Q1 print is unlikely, and the outlook commentary has a strong Q2 start to point to.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY guide of +150m OP issued 2026-07-15 15:30: +4.66% the next session, then -5.72% the day after. No intra-year revision has been made on this plan yet. The previous management cut its FY2025 plan on 2025-05-09.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-28 (also https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260914/140120260914535848.pdf 2026-09-14 and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260928/140120260928540767.pdf 2026-09-28; Q2 FY26 auction gross derived from H1 FY26 1,629,965k yen minus Q1 548,525k yen in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260113/140120260113532234.pdf)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since the September results are public; the stock fell 1.4% on the day the 507m yen autumn sale was disclosed. The only part that may not be priced: a holder looking at a Q1 loss against a +150m plan cannot see Q2's run-rate in the short itself, so a held plan plus Sept commentary removes the 'off-track' reading.
findings.independence: Shares the auction-notice series with finding 1 but covers a different quarter (Q2, not Q1). Same company, same disclosure channel, so not independent.

findings.finding: Margin long was 3.24m shares against zero margin short on 2026-07-31, about 29% of shares outstanding and many weeks of volume. A Q1 that is still a loss, against a +150m yen plan, hands leveraged retail holders a 赤字 headline to sell into, as happened on last year's Q1 (-8.45%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 赤字転落 headline: -8.45% (2025-10-14). The April 2026 cascade of -5.8%, -9.6%, -15.2% and -18.0% came days after a flat Q3 reaction, which is consistent with margin liquidation rather than the print.
findings.why_not_priced: The margin balance is public, but the size of the overhang relative to float is not in the baseline (margin_ratio null) and is only visible in daily-publication data. If it had already been unwound, volume since August would show it; volume has been 6k-180k shares a day, far below the 3.2m position, so most of it is probably still there. Stale data: the position may have shrunk since July.
findings.independence: Prior-year Q1 reaction from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2437.T?range=2y&interval=1d). A different source, but only one analogous event.

Returns: dividend 未定, and no buyback or benefit change was seen at the last two prints (the benefit was changed to a Quo card on 2026-04-13, at the Q3 print). New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q1 is seasonally the weakest (no auctions in August); FY26 Q1 was -203m against a later FY of -144m, and FY25 Q1 was +43m against a FY of +12m. A Q1 loss of roughly -70 to -110m against a +150 plan is in line with seasonality, not an off-track signal.
baseline_tension: The findings net to a slight positive (+0.4) while the tape has slipped 6.2% over five days and the lean reads +1.17, so they agree weakly with the lean and cut slightly against the run-in. The strongest positive this release could carry is a held plan with Q2 commentary, or a dividend decision, and I looked for both: the plan is held, nothing was filed on dividends. The strongest negative is a still-loss Q1 meeting a crowded margin long. Both are public, so p_up sits at 51.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the positioning negative rests on public margin data and on a Q1 loss anyone can compute from the auction notices, so it shrank from -0.6 to -0.4. p_up was already near 50.

Rule 2 (check the sign): negatives do not outnumber positives here (2 positive, 1 negative). I wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I looked for it (held plan, dividend, buyback). This moved p_up from 50 to 51.
The positive findings were left at their sizes. They were already sized small for resting on public auction notices, and the file's rules speak to negatives.
